body_markdown:
I have been trying to deploy openreplay via EKS for some time now, and there are many unexpected issues popping up. the latest one I am facing is sink and storage are on seperate nodes and needs a shared EFS to function, but VPC in my clusters is not configured the way that openreplay expects it.
Is there any way to keep sink and storage as a single node?


The hosting is done, and it lists many recordings, but I am unable to view it because the sessions themselves were never written to my S3 bucket.
